title: ExtremeCore
description: Turns your world into total hell, or something even worse. I hate you.
body:
### Tired of the usual Hardcore?
ExtremeCore gives you a chance to experience true difficulty and feel what it's like to be completely helpless.

# What does ExtremeCore do?
- **Smart Zombies**: They have learned to break blocks if they know you are hiding behind them.
- **Tougher Skeletons**: Skeletons now have +200% HP.
- **Ender Gaze**: Endermen will now paralyze you for a short time if they catch you looking at them.
- **Killer Bats**: Bats are now untouchable and deal 1 HP of damage.
- **Trident Mastery**: Drowned now have a 100% chance to spawn with a trident.
- **Charged Chaos**: And for dessert — Creepers are always charged.

**Starting Stats**:
To make things "fair," you start your journey with only 3 hearts and 5 hunger points.

**The Nether is now a true Hell**:
Piglins will no longer spare you just because you're wearing gold. If you try to offer it to them, they will simply ignore you and continue the hunt.

As for the End...
Don't worry about it. You won't make it that far.

And one more liiiittle problem: Hearts do not regenerate without potions or golden apples...

To enable ExtremeCore, enable vanilla Hardcore mode.

**Credits & Inspiration**:
This project was inspired by the [SuperHardcore](https://modrinth.com/mod/superhardcore) mod.
